mapper.sql: FROM mkt01_target_company WHERE mkt01_company_id = #{companyId} AND mkt01_item_type_cd LIKE '%' AND COALESCE(mkt01_unuse_yn,'false') != 'true' AND UPPER(CONCAT(mkt01_target_company_nm, mkt01_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})

FROM mkt01_target_company LEFT OUTER JOIN mkt02_manager ON mkt02_target_company_id = mkt01_target_company_id WHERE 1=1 AND mkt01_company_id = #{companyId} AND mkt01_item_type_cd LIKE '%' AND COALESCE(mkt01_unuse_yn,'false') != 'true' AND UPPER(CONCAT(mkt01_target_company_nm, mkt02_manager_nm)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
mapper.select:
SELECT t.mkt01_target_company_id AS target_company_id , t.mkt01_manager_id AS manager_id , t.mkt01_target_company_nm AS target_company_name , t.mkt01_manager_nm AS manager_name , t.mkt01_manager_org_nm AS manager_org_name FROM ( SELECT mkt01_target_company_id , mkt01_target_company_nm , mkt02_manager_id AS mkt01_manager_id , mkt02_manager_nm AS mkt01_manager_nm , mkt02_org_nm AS mkt01_manager_org_nm
) t ORDER BY t.mkt01_target_company_nm collate "ko_KR.utf8" asc LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
